title: Shade or a smoother path?
goal: Recommend a council project within a budget while addressing competing access and comfort needs.
evidence: Choice cites both resident views, calculates remaining funds and acknowledges a trade-off.
lesson: Apply agreed decision criteria after learning about local services.
brief: Assembly notes A. Heading 'Which park improvement should we fund?' Badge 'Simulated local council'. Budget '$24,000 • one-off funds'. Two equal proposal panels 'Shade shelter $18,000' and 'Smooth accessible path $22,000'. Quotes 'The picnic area gets very hot.' and 'The rough path stops me reaching the picnic area.' Small inclusive park illustration, wheelchair user represented naturally. No preferred option. Blank 'My recommendation', 'Funds left: $', 'A need still unmet'. Primary 'Prepare my statement'. Prompt 'Use both views and a cost.' Keep plum, peach and sage assembly identity; minimise council-room scenery to leave answer space.
